description: On Linux the main window starts on the cover page (cover.rs), in its only web view: it may drag the window, ask which server is open, load it again once it is reachable, or step aside; for the server here, start it, turn reach off, copy its details, read Tailscale's state (whether there is its app to open) or open Tailscale; for a server out of reach or the server here stopped, open the welcome window or another server of the app's list. Only for the app's own (local) pages, never the site's.
